revisions.goal: Fix the plan approval UI state messaging and show a toolbar/menu-bar waiting indicator when plans are pending.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria:
- A stale plan never shows contradictory locked/approved copy or an active approve button
- Locked and stale status rendering is mutually exclusive and reflects the current request state
- The macOS menu-bar icon visibly indicates when one or more plans are waiting
- Tests cover stale/locked UI state selection and pending icon state where practical

milestones.title: Fix approval copy/actions
milestones.goal: Make stale and locked states render consistent status and disabled actions

milestones.title: Add waiting icon indicator
milestones.goal: Change the menu-bar icon when pending plan count is non-zero

milestones.title: Verify UI behavior
milestones.goal: Run focused UI and macOS tests plus build checks
